import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette for fraud/non-fraud
colors = ['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c']  # Green for legitimate, Red for fraud

# Plot 1: Distribution of transaction amounts by fraud status
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for fraud_status, color in zip([0, 1], colors):
    subset = df[df['is_fraud'] == fraud_status]['amount']
    label = 'Fraud' if fraud_status == 1 else 'Legitimate'
    ax1.hist(subset, bins=30, alpha=0.6, label=label, color=color, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Fraud rate by transaction type
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
fraud_by_type = df.groupby('transaction_type')['is_fraud'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
fraud_by_type['fraud_rate'] = (fraud_by_type['sum'] / fraud_by_type['count']) * 100
fraud_by_type = fraud_by_type.sort_values('fraud_rate', ascending=True)

bars = ax2.barh(fraud_by_type.index, fraud_by_type['fraud_rate'], color='#3498db', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Fraud Rate by Transaction Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar, val in zip(bars, fraud_by_type['fraud_rate']):
    ax2.text(val + 0.5, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:.1f}%', 
             va='center', fontsize=10)

# Plot 3: Transactions by hour of day (stacked bar)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hourly_data = df.groupby(['hour_of_day', 'is_fraud']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
hourly_data.columns = ['Legitimate', 'Fraud']
hourly_data.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax3, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Transaction Volume by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Transaction Status')
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=8)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Plot 4: Box plot of transaction amounts by fraud status and transaction type
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['Fraud Status'] = df['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Legitimate', 1: 'Fraud'})
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='Fraud Status', 
            ax=ax4, palette={'Legitimate': colors[0], 'Fraud': colors[1]})
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Transaction Amounts by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Status')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()
plt.subplots_adjust(top=0.93)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
